pli-tv-bi-vb-pc61:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc61:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo gabbhiniṃ vuṭṭhāpenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc61:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo gabbhiniṃ vuṭṭhāpessantitī.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc61:1.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc61:1.9: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc61:1.10: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo gabbhiniṃ vuṭṭhāpessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc61:1.11: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo gabbhiniṃ vuṭṭhāpentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc61:1.14: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo gabbhiniṃ vuṭṭhāpessanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc61:1.16: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc61:1.17.1: yā pana bhikkhunī gabbhiniṃ vuṭṭhāpeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc61:2.1.9: vuṭṭhāpessāmīti gaṇaṃ vā ācariniṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati sīmaṃ vā sammannati āpatti dukkaṭassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc61:2.1.13: gaṇassa ca ācariniyā ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
